title: Los Andes vs Prueba
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "Los Andes vs Prueba", at revision 1370627114, opens: "Los Andes vs Prueba was a single ship action fought in 1820, during the development of the Spanish American Wars of Independence. 
The battle was between the corvette Los Andes and the frigate Prueba, the first a Chilean privateer and the second a ship of the Spanish Navy. It lasted two days and occurred in two different places. There are differences between Chilean and Spanish historiography on the exact date, the starting place, the development and the result of the naval action." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q52696693, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1820 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
